name: Electricity demand service
description: This calculation service publishes values for an electricity demand profile. The values of the profile should be specified in the ESDL file.

relevant_links.name: EnvironmentalProfiles
relevant_links.description: Details on the EnvironmentalProfiles esdl type

calculations.name: predict demand
calculations.description: Send the values of the electricity demand profile for the coming 12 hours.

outputs.name: active_power
outputs.description: The active power demand as vector of floats for the next 12 hours in watts.

outputs.name: reactive_power
outputs.description: The reactive power demand as vector of floats for the next 12 hours in watts.

calculations.name: current demand
calculations.description: Send the current values of the electricity demand profile for the coming 15 minutes.

outputs.name: current_active_power
outputs.description: The active power demand as vector of floats for the next 15 minutes in watts.

outputs.name: current_reactive_power
outputs.description: The reactive power demand as vector of floats for the next 15 minutes in watts.
